FN-YMC51N6-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 367
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/13/2026
Senate Bill 367 as introduced would appropriate a total of up to $203,404,327 in federal Rural
Health Transformation Program funds, for various initiatives, to the Alabama Department of
Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA) for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
In addition, this bill would provide that all funds not expended in the current fiscal year shall not
revert but shall be carried forward and used for the purposes appropriated as provided by this
bill.
